voice.status: Exact selected pass1 take has an immutable hosted asset identity. Hosted Linux must stream-verify its bytes, SHA-256 and PCM WAV properties before any candidate render; no revoice. It has not been listened to or AV-approved.

world: Source-page evidence pane to clearly illustrative accounts-control scene; no reconstructed broadcast footage or presenter.
signature_concept: A supplier bank-detail change stays pending while the operator calls only a number already held; call start alone never releases payment.
transitions: At frame zero, Channel 4’s authentic logo and release date sit above a large editorial hook: “THE REVEAL / CAME LAST”. This is our framing, not a source quotation; it promises a late reveal without showing the quoted words. The underline moves immediately while the hook remains legible.

“ON LOCATION” is visible at the B02 cut. The exact contiguous source fragment “I’m not real.” appears only at 7.644s, the locked narration onset of “I’m”; it replaces the setup with the source-attributed quote.
The source phrase leads; three small rails name its three linked elements below the source card.
A single verified line gets the full card width; the empty perforation strip sits below it.
The quotation opens with the setup clause only, holding the exact continuation for the next cut.
The verbatim continuation resolves the quote; no presenter image or reconstructed footage.
The exact source description is set as a four-line reading panel rather than compressed into a full-page miniature.
The full attribution is retained and given its own large speaker-introduction card.
The warning begins as a short, high-emphasis phrase; attribution remains visible.
The exact continuation completes the same warning across the beat seam; Channel 4 material ends after this card.

With all Channel 4 material gone, build one generic accounts workstation and a supplier change request. No names, values, account digits, caller image or simulated speech. A physical latch reads PAYMENT HELD.
Rotate a large one-rule plate beside the request. Keep the blank request and held latch in view; no claim of measured security outcome.
Separate the change slip from the message path; the payment latch remains shut. The form stays free of real or invented account details.

Connect the handset only to the saved-contact tile. Lift it and begin an outgoing call, but keep the pending latch closed and label the state CALL STARTED. No answer, confirmation, or automatic release.
A message-origin route stops at a red physical barrier. The trusted route remains available, but the call has not been answered and the payment is still pending.
Keep the change pending. Remove all Channel 4 evidence and branding. Show the exact spoken follow CTA plus the audit URL; no resolved transaction or call-success sound.
